svg.text: Storage Accounts (Zero-Key GCP Service Accounts) & GCS HNS Managed Folder Hierarchy
Replaces Legacy Shared Storage Account Keys & ADLS Gen2 POSIX ACLs with Subfolder-Scoped google_storage_managed_folder_iam_member Bindings
Cross-cloud ingestion identity; cannot read Gold tables
Role: Unity Catalog Storage Credential Master
Vends short-lived downscoped OAuth tokens to clusters
Zero access to RWD or CMC Manufacturing folders
Zero access to Clinical DDF or CMC folders
Zero access to unblinded Clinical DDF folders
Why This Matters for GxP & Least Privilege:
Denodo VDP cannot bypass Databricks Unity Catalog to read raw
Bronze/Silver GCS files; it queries Databricks via JDBC only.
PRIMARY GCS HNS BUCKET: gs://gke-demos-363017-rd-lakehouse-hns (hierarchical_namespace = true)
Exposed via Unity Catalog + Denodo VDP
• Links Drug Substance -> Clinical Lot ID
Shared Platform Managed Folders (Inside Primary HNS Bucket)
• hive_warehouse/ -> External Hive Metastore (Cloud SQL HA) root URI
• unity_catalog/ -> Unity Catalog managed tables & lineage metadata
• denodo_cache/ -> Denodo 8.0 MPP Parquet/Delta spill directory
Why GCS Hierarchical Namespace (HNS) Is Mandatory:
1. Atomic O(1) RenameFolder: Eliminates slow O(N) object copy+delete
during Spark task/job commits and Delta Lake _delta_log checkpoints.
2. 5x–8x Higher Per-Prefix QPS: Eliminates HTTP 429 throttling on deep
30-Year GxP WORM Regulatory Lock (21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11):
Guarantees immutable, tamper-proof preservation of locked clinical
trial datasets (CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and CMC batch release certificates
with Object Versioning + Cloud KMS CMEK encryption.
